title: A Space stores its Mega Theme and niche, on one theme id model
detail: Adds lib/theme/mega-theme.ts: MEGA_THEMES maps one theme id to the editor theme and site theme, MEGA_NICHES names the six niches, and readMegaTheme/withMegaTheme store the choice at spaces.preferences.megaTheme. Space creation seeds the niche, and the owner profile save sets or clears either part. No table, no content rewrite.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; vitest lib/theme/mega-theme.test.ts pins the map to the older tables and round-trips the stored choice.
